answer: The design leans on random re-execution by unrelated peers, released only after three unrelated confirmations, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. What survives to the zenith is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Work waits on the karst until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the nebula of the next round. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce.
